dominant_breach: aggregate sovereign wealth can be mistaken for household claim security unless the fiscal-rule transfer, raiding firewall, investment-risk tolerance, and ordinary-claimant link are explicit
fastest_washout: a strong fund can become a comforting average if market drawdown, oil-transition, fiscal-rule transfer, and claimant-floor effects are not stress-tested

public_balance_sheet_gate.note: The GPFG is a strong public-asset governance benchmark, but it still needs claimant-link and drawdown-stress scoring before it is used as a comfort counterweight.

sovereign_wealth_fund_rule_bound_governa.note: NBIM reporting, the Santiago Principles context, and Norway fiscal-rule materials support rule-bound public-asset governance.

public_asset_distributional_claim.note: The public owns the asset, but the household-level distributional claim is mediated through the budget and fiscal-rule transfer, not individual accounts.

public_asset_raiding_firewall.note: The fiscal framework and broad political support are strong, but stress testing must show the firewall during downturns or political pressure.

resource_revenue_smoothing_rule.note: The fiscal guideline links spending over time to expected real return and budget transfers, creating a transparent smoothing rule.

public_backstop_seniority_waterfall.note: The waterfall must show when current budget users, future cohorts, and fund governance are senior under market-drawdown stress.

proof_debt: stress test of fiscal-rule transfers under large market drawdown and oil-transition pressure
explicit claimant link between GPFG-funded budget space and ordinary household floors/services
intergenerational distribution of fund use, including current-budget transfer versus future cohort preservation
governance/raiding firewall under political stress and extraordinary fiscal need
domestic inequality offset and public-service delivery financed by fund transfers

gate_20_public_balance_sheet.why: The case may serve as a positive benchmark, but comfort certification still requires a drawdown, fiscal-rule transfer, ordinary-claimant, and intergenerational-incidence stress package.

public_balance_sheet_register.exposure_name: Government Pension Fund Global public asset, fiscal-rule transfer, and intergenerational governance surface
public_balance_sheet_register.legal_authority: Norwegian fiscal policy guideline, GPFG mandate, Ministry of Finance strategy, Norges Bank management mandate, Storting oversight, ethics and responsible-investment framework
public_balance_sheet_register.claimant_perimeter: Norwegian public, current budget users, future cohorts, public-service users, taxpayers, fund governance bodies, and investee-market counterparties

indirect: domestic groups depending on fiscal-rule choices

public_balance_sheet_register.maximum_exposure: Full fund market value and expected real-return budget-transfer capacity, subject to investment risk, currency, equity-market, and political/fiscal-rule stress.
public_balance_sheet_register.expected_loss: Not a bailout loss; risk appears as lower future budget transfers, pressure to exceed the fiscal guideline, weakened intergenerational preservation, or reduced ordinary public-service capacity after drawdowns.
public_balance_sheet_register.stress_scenario: Large global equity drawdown, oil-transition shock, or domestic fiscal pressure tests the rule that fund spending should track expected real return and remain below the guideline in normal years.
public_balance_sheet_register.funding_source: Petroleum revenue savings, investment returns, fund transfers to cover the non-oil deficit, and ordinary fiscal policy.
public_balance_sheet_register.loss_sharing: Market risk is publicly borne; political loss sharing occurs through current spending restraint, future-cohort preservation, taxes, and service levels.
public_balance_sheet_register.public_upside_recovery: The public retains upside through fund ownership, long-term compounding, fiscal-rule transfers, and budget capacity if governance is preserved.
public_balance_sheet_register.ordinary_claimant_protection: Protect ordinary services, claimant floors, and future-cohort claims before treating aggregate fund value as generic national wealth.
public_balance_sheet_register.sunset_or_review: Annual NBIM/government white-paper refresh; immediate review after fiscal-guideline change, large market drawdown, mandate change, or extraordinary withdrawal.
